## Load in Packages and Data

```{r load packages and data}

#install(dplyr)
#install(ggplot2)
#install.packages(here)

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(here)

read.csv(here("data","processed","abundance_data.csv")) %>%
  View("abundance_data.csv")


```

##Plot Line Graph for Daily Temperature

```{r}

daily_temperature_data <- read.csv(here("data","processed","daily_temp_data.csv"))

ggplot(data = daily_temperature_data, 
       aes(x=date,y=mean_temp)
       ) +
  geom_line()

```
